delivery.title: Okuhitsyaho - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" aha nikimanyisa ngu target server egarukiremu HTTP 2xx status - tikirikuhamya ngu enkora y'okutunga buzima ekabiikwa nari ekakora aha kwebembera. Kyebera omubiri gw’okugarukamu aharuguru eki gwagambire buzima; ku kiraabe kiri busha nari okuhamya kwonka, enkora egyo neebaasa kuba neetunga okushaba kwonka erikwanga nari neegaya omushaara gw’okushashura omunda (amaziina g’ebicweka/omuringo ogutahikire ogwa API yaayo , omusiri ogurikwetengyesa aha rubaju rwayo ogu omushaara gw’okushashura ogu gutarimu, n’ebindi).

push.title: Webhooks z'aheeru - Push Leads & Ebirikugarurwaho
push.intro: Nikibaasa kuhindurwa omu bwijwire buri webhook : JSON , Foomu (x-www-foomu-urlencoded), nari omubiri gwawe ogw'omutaano ogurimu <fieldkey></fieldkey> emyanya y'okukwatiraho (nk'eky'okureeberaho <example></example> > ) - nikikora nk'okwijuza ekiragiro cURL omurundi gumwe.
push.curlHelp: Taho ekyokureeberaho kyokushaba ebihandiiko byabo API nari Postman ebi arikukuha (n’ebihandiiko by’amazima nari eby’okureeberaho). URL , omuringo n’emitwe nibikopwa nk’oku biri, kandi buri kishumuruzo omu mubiri kihandiikirwe ahaifo kugira ngu obaasa kutoorana omwanya gwa CRM ogurikukijuza ahari buri mwebembezi.
push.curlManual: Tebeekanisa omu ngaro omu mwanya gwayo
push.curlPrompt: Oine cURL y'omuguzi ? <action>Import kuruga omu cURL</action> kwijuza eki omu maapu y'ebicweka by'okwekorera.
push.urlVariables: URL neebaasa kuba erimu ebirikuhinduka, nk'eky'okureeberaho <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Emitwe eshemerire kuba eri JSON ehikire , nk {{example}}
push.authTitle: Okuhamya (oku Leadrat erikutaaha omu API yaabo )
push.modeSame: Yohereza buri kimwe aha URL niyo emwe
push.modeCreateUpdate: Taho rikodi omurundi gumwe, reero ohindure rikodi niyo emwe (tihariho ebirikugarukagaruka aha rubaju rwabo)
push.responseIdRequired: ID yaabo ya rikodi omu kugarukamu *
push.responseIdHint: Aho ID eri omu kugarukamu kwabo JSON aha kushaba kw’okuhanga. Bibiikire buri kwebembera nka <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Aha bwire oburikuhwaho, enshobi za HTTP 429 na 5xx - bwanyima y‘edakiika 1, edakiika 5, edakiika 30, eshaaha 2, eshaaha 6.
push.howFilled: Oku emihendo erikwijuzibwa: webhook egi neegaruka ekoresibwa ahari buri mwebembezi - Leadrat terikwohereza eky‘okureeberaho ekitaine mpinduka, neeyohereza okusindika okusya buri murundi ogu ekintu ekitoorainwe kirikubaho, n‘emihendo y‘omwebembezi OGWO eriho hati.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Foomu neekora buri kimwe aha rubaju rw'okubanza - tihaine eky'okutebeekanisa.
push.howFilledCustom: Omugyenzo - handiika omubiri gwawe gw'okushaba kandi ote omu hoona; buri kimwe nikihindurwa omuhendo gwenyini gw’omwebembezi ogwo kitakasindikire. Nyiga ekirikuhinduka ahaifo kukitamu.

receive.title: Kwakiira - Yikiriza okwebembera omu muringo gwona
receive.intro: Buri nshonga neetunga URL yaayo . Point Facebook lead ads, Zapier , foomu ya weebu saiti nari webhook endiijo eya CRM ahariyo - niboohereza abarikwebembera omu JSON yaabo nari omu muringo gwa foomu, kandi iwe okore maapu y’emisiri yaabo n’eyaawe.
receive.urlIntro: URL yaawe ey'okutunga - ha eki aha nkora y'okusindika ( POST , JSON nari foomu-ehandiikirwe):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Okukora URL ensya ? Owa ira arekyera aho kukora ahonaaho.
receive.sendExample: Yohereza eky‘okureeberaho kimwe okubanza - nikikwatwa nk‘eky‘okureeberaho (tihariho ekirikureeta omu ihanga kuhitsya obu maapu eri ahaifo eraabiikwe).
receive.securityAuthTitle: Yikiriza okushaba okuteirweho omukono n'ekihama eki kyonka
receive.sampleLabel: Ekyokureberaho payload (taho kimwe, nari orekyeho busha kukozesa okushaba okuhererukireyo okutungirwe)

pull.title: Kurura - Reeta abarikwebembera kuruga ahari API yoona
pull.intro: Leadrat neeyeta API y’enkora endiijo aha ntebeekanisa (auth yoona, paging yoona) kandi neereeta ebihandiiko ebi eri kugarurayo. Records ezi ereebire zitakahinduire update lead niyo emwe.
pull.variables: Ebirikuhinduka: <since></since> (okugyendera aha businguzi oburikuhererukayo, obwire bwa ISO; busha omurundi gw’okubanza), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Biika, reero Fetch sample - Leadrat neeyeta API omurundi gumwe (orupapura rw'okubanza rwonka) kandi taine eki erikureeta omu ihanga.

api.title: API yaawe - Emiringo ebiri y'okutunga enkora yoona
api.intro: Enkora yoona erimu ekishumuruzo kyawe API neebaasa kuhanga, kushoma n’okugaruza busya abarikwebembera n’okuhandiikisa aha mikoro y’abeebembezi. Yohereza ekishumuruzo omu mutwe gwa <hdr></hdr> , nka <bearer></bearer> , nari (ekikwato kyaba kitarikubaasa kutaho emitwe) nka <query></query> . Ekikomo: {{limit}} okushaba buri dakiika.
api.noPermission: Omuntu wenka oine orusa rwa Manage Settings niwe arikubaasa kureeba ekishumuruzo API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa ekishumuruzo eki hati okibike omu mwanya ogutarimu kabi - ahabw'obukuumi nikyorekwa omurundi gumwe gwonka. Ku eraabe ebuzire, reetaho ensya.
api.regenerateConfirm: Okukora ekishumuruzo kisya API ? Ekishumuruzo ekiriho hati nikirekyera aho kukora ahonaaho ahari buri nkora erikukikozesa.
api.openApiHint: Reeta OpenAPI spec omu Postman , Zapier , Make nari n8n kutunga buri nshonga y'okuhendera eyeteekateekire kukoresibwa.
